description: Every Microsoft.AppComplianceAutomation operation needs the caller's token a second time in the `x-ms-aad-user-token` header (documented in the ACAT CI/CD guide, absent from the spec); without it even GET /reports fails with HTTP 502 `BearerFallbackDisabled`. Add an optional sensitive `userToken` header member to every operation input.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The caller's Microsoft Entra token, `Bearer <token>`. Microsoft.AppComplianceAutomation acts on behalf of this token and refuses requests without it (HTTP 502 `BearerFallbackDisabled`).
